title: Proper birational modifications are isomorphisms near codimension one
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $f:Y\to X$ a proper birational morphism with $Y$ reduced [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-reduced-scheme]. Birational means inducing isomorphisms on the local rings at the generic points, with those generic points in bijection. The maximal open subset of $X$ over which $f$ is an isomorphism contains every codimension-zero point and every codimension-one point whose local ring is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring]. It also contains every point with normal local ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] over which the fibre is finite.
